notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has at least two burden counters on it and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing The One Ring to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.
